svg.text: User Flow — two journeys, one platform
A customer screens a payment before sending it; an AML analyst works the alerts the Risk Engine raised.
JOURNEY A · USER PORTAL — "Is this payment safe?"
paste a URL → phishing heuristics score + reasons
side tool in the same portal
JOURNEY B · INVESTIGATION WORKBENCH — "Is this account part of a ring?"
double-click a node → re-centre, follow the ring
An opened case pre-fills the portal composer —
change amount, method or time and watch the
verdict move. Same model, same reasons.
